_notes.creditRate: Credits per character, and the only thing left in this file. ElevenLabs bills round(characters x rate) and the rate belongs to the plan, not the request. Measured at 0.607 over the first 44 generated lines on this account with eleven_v3 -- an earlier 0.55 taken from the sibling project understated the bill by 10%. A FALLBACK ONLY: tools/voice/generate.mjs measures the rate from the manifest's own generated lines whenever it has any, and the site's estimate is calibrated from what the account has actually been charged. This is what a clone with an empty manifest gets. Which voice, model, settings and pronunciation dictionary a line is cut with are the database's -- the generating editor's generation_preference, the /voices roster and pronunciation_lexicon -- because generation happens on the droplet against the signed-in editor's own account.
